text: Good evening. Mi a try get through to somebody fi nearly a hour now, an mi nuh appreciate being left waiting so. Is mi grandson Jayden, him is 8 years old, an him temperature reach 38.4 tonight. Now dis is di ting I don't like, an maybe is nothing, maybe mi a fret fi nothing, but from evening him keep beg mi fi turn off di lamp. When mi open di bedroom door an di landing light shine in, him put him two hand over him face an turn to di wall, an him say it hurting him eye dem. Him nuh even want di TV on, an dat boy love him TV. Mi pull di curtain dem tight an put a towel over di lampshade an him still squinting up himself. Mi nuh know if is just how fever tek him, but mi never see him behave so before. Please, somebody just call mi back and tell mi what fi do, cause mi tired fi wait.
